description: Delivered 1966 in the HC-130P block 66-0211/0225; Vietnam service; assigned to the 106th Rescue Wing from 1997; last flown 7 Mar 2019 and decommissioned in place with the 102nd Rescue Squadron; towed to the front gate 16-17 Aug 2021 as gate guardian; known as Triple Deuce
museum_name: Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base

description: Built as a CH-3E in the block 66-13285/13290 and converted to HH-3E; to AMARC as HH0026 18 Mar 1991; Baugher records it on display with the New York ANG at Westhampton Beach; the April 2016 NMUSAF loan list charges it to 106 MXS/CC; stands alongside the HC-130 at the front gate per the Air National Guard article of Aug 2021 and a Nov 2021 local feature
museum_name: Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base
